h: The Holiness We Give Returns Through Sacred Eating

p: "And it shall be for Aharon and his sons,
and they shall eat it in a holy place" (Vayikra 24:9).
and wrote that it refers to the bread,
while "and it shall be" refers to the offering.
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, wrote
to each one of the arrangements.
the pasuk opened "and it shall be"
and ended "and they shall eat it" in the masculine;
and if it refers to the offering
"for it is holy of holies to him":
in parashas Ki Sisa it says (Shemos 31:14),
whoever does work on it, etc."
and in parashas Vayakhel it is written (Shemos 35:2),
And it is as is written in the holy Zohar
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ צב, ב וְחֵלֶק ב צב, א)
And it is according to what they said
the Holy One, blessed is He, said to it:
כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא בֶּן זוּגֵךְ כוּ׳
Knesses Yisrael is your partner, etc."
"Remember the day of Shabbos to sanctify it."
and Shabbos is referred to in the feminine,
And nevertheless it is written "to sanctify it,"
becomes in the aspect of male
For Yisrael instill holiness into Shabbos
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת עֵקֶב)
(as they said in Midrash Rabbah, beginning of Eikev, Devarim Rabbah 3:1)
holiness from the eating of Shabbos.
And in the manner of what is written
"'And I shall be sanctified among Bnei Yisrael' (Vayikra 22:32)
and afterward 'I am Hashem Who sanctifies you.'"
And likewise with Shabbos, it is written "to sanctify it"
and it is written, "For I am Hashem Who sanctifies you"
to receive the holiness of Shabbos,
shall a person sanctify himself? etc.
the holy Name 'Hashem of Hosts,' etc.
and we do not do so,
and afterward, when a person reaches
'The whole earth is full of His glory,'
as it is written, 'I am Hashem Who sanctifies you':
the Name Havayah is the Holy One, blessed is He."
And the earlier ones, at "Hashem of Hosts,"
"and we do not do so, etc.,
which is "And I shall be sanctified
and the drawing of holiness below
is when one reaches the attribute of Knesses Yisrael,
which is "The whole earth is full of His glory"
is in the union of "I" and Havayah,
which is "The whole earth is full of His glory."
And with Shabbos too it is written,
and there are likewise the two levels
"And it shall be for Aharon and his sons":
shall be for Aharon and his sons;
each Kohen who received an olive's bulk
some ate it and were satisfied,
and some ate it and left over, etc."
Yet an olive's bulk is not enough to satisfy,
and which is it? An egg's bulk."
Nevertheless a Kohen who received an olive's bulk
and this was through the holiness
that Shimon HaTzaddik the Kohen Gadol put
(as is written in the holy Zohar there).
and according to the preparation of the Kohen who ate it,
so the blessing rested in their innards:
some ate it and were satisfied,
and some ate it and left over.
And this is why it says "and it shall be"
and this is "for Aharon," the Kohen Gadol,
that all of them should put holiness into the bread.
as is written in the holy Zohar
so as not to bring accusation, etc.;
the food that comes out from the Table
blesses the food of the Kohanim, etc."
That is: the eating of the Showbread
for all the meals they ever ate,
That is why it is written afterward
"and they shall eat it" in the masculine:
the one that bestows holiness upon the Kohanim;
כִּי קוֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים הוּא לוֹ וְגוֹ׳
"for it is holy of holies to him, etc.,"
for the bread bestows holiness upon them.
And this is what it says in the haftarah
they shall come into My Sanctuary,
and they shall approach My Table
and did not specify other services
the incense, the preparing of the lamps and the like?
And likewise afterward it is written (Yechezkel 44:24),
in all My festivals they shall keep,
and My Shabbosos they shall sanctify."
Why did it specify sanctifying Shabbosos?
"In all My festivals they shall keep"
that it refers to offering the mussafin;
they being the teachers of Yisrael,
"And My people they shall teach, etc."?
But the matter is as we said:
to the Kohanim Shabbos was given,
that they instill holiness into Shabbos.
"And they shall approach My Table to minister to Me":
that they instill holiness and blessing
and likewise "My Shabbosos they shall sanctify":
and Shabbos is a Name of the Holy One, blessed is He
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
and when one delights in Shabbos
which is called the King's feast,
And its essence is in the Showbread,
which is called "the bread of their God,"
for Kohanim are the agents of the Merciful One,
and it is called "the bread of their God,"
for He spoke and His will was done.
which is akin to the Showbread,
and for this reason one sets out twelve challos.
And the principal mitzvah was given to the Kohanim
that the Shabbos eating of Yisrael
And just as the Kohanim receive holiness
for the eating of all the days,
so the eating of Yisrael on Shabbos helps
into all the eating of Yisrael always,
And this is "My Shabbosos they shall sanctify."

inlineHeadings.text: Shabbos Both Receives and Bestows Holiness
The Kohanim Bless the Bread That Sanctifies Them
The Shabbos Table Shares the Showbread Holiness
